title: LIBRA: Measuring Bias of Large Language Model from a Local Context
findings: Religion was included as one of eight social groups for stereotypical bias evaluation, making up 0.45% of the test cases. However, the paper does not report specific findings or bias scores for the religion category, focusing instead on aggregate results across all categories.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured stereotypical bias against various social groups, including religion, within a local New Zealand context. The evaluation was based on a triplet structure (stereotyped, anti-stereotyped, irrelevant sentences) to assess model preferences.
